items.summary: Official, Anthropic-managed directory of high quality Claude Code Plugins.

items.summary: Turn any AI agent into an AI Scientist. Compatible with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Pi, Antigravity, and the open Agent Skills standard.
items.recommend_reason_zh: K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills 汇集177个即用且经验证的科学技能和100多个科研数据库，覆盖生物、化学、医学与药物发现，能让AI代理变身科研助手，值得打开体验。
items.recommend_reason_en: K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills is an agent skills library offering 177 validated science skills and 100+ scientific databases across biology, chemistry, medicine, and drug discovery, worth opening to turn an AI agent into an AI scientist.
